method: Typed collector turns, Realtime audio responses; no microphone or browser test.

turns.speaker: Collector
turns.text: Hi, may I speak with Rachel Carter? This is Alex from Orion Capital Solutions. Before discussing the private matter, could you confirm your date of birth and mailing address?

turns.speaker: Rachel
turns.text: Hi, this is Rachel. …Okay, yes, I can confirm. My date of birth is March 4th, 1995. My mailing address is 132 Market Street, Twin City, Minnesota.

turns.speaker: Collector
turns.text: Thank you, verification is complete. This is an attempt to collect your Huntington Debt Holdings account, with a balance of $1,808.56. Your previous arrangement defaulted after a missed payment and no replacement is active. What would you like to clarify before we discuss options?

turns.speaker: Rachel
turns.text: Okay, I got it. I mean, I kinda expected it to be about the previous arrangement. I did recently try to set up something online, but I’m not totally sure if I clicked everything I needed to. I’m not sure if the message was an email or a text, either. So, yeah, I’d like to understand if there’s currently no arrangement active, and what happens if I try to set one up again.

turns.speaker: Collector
turns.text: Correct, no arrangement is active. I cannot tell why the online attempt was not completed, but we can agree on a new plan without you using the website. Is now a convenient time for a short discussion, and what payment amount would feel manageable?

turns.speaker: Rachel
turns.text: Alright, thanks for clarifying. I can talk for a bit, that’s fine. I’m not sure what amount I could comfortably do, maybe something smaller at first? I don’t want to set anything too big before I get home and consider my options. Could you explain how a plan would work without me browsing online?

turns.speaker: Collector
turns.text: We can discuss the amount and dates verbally, and you can decide whether they fit before authorizing anything. One option is $150 monthly starting December 1, then on the first of each month, with the last payment adjusted to the remaining balance. No website is needed for this discussion. Would that fit, or would a different amount or date work better?

turns.speaker: Rachel
turns.text:
Okay, that actually sounds a bit more doable than I expected. And since you’ll adjust the last payment based on the remaining balance, that helps.

I’d like to confirm it’s monthly on the first starting December 1, and then the last payment will be whatever’s left. I don’t want to commit to something too tight, but 150 bucks a month, that’s worth considering.

turns.speaker: Collector
turns.text: Yes, exactly: $150 each month on the first, beginning December 1, with a smaller final payment if that is all that remains. This is an installment plan, not a settlement of the full balance today. You do not need to decide just because I ask; is that schedule manageable enough that you want to agree to it now?

turns.speaker: Rachel
turns.text: Yeah, I think that could work. I’d prefer not to lock anything in blindly, but that plan with the smaller final payment feels reasonable. If that’s how it’ll work, I’m comfortable agreeing to that.

turns.speaker: Collector
turns.text: Thank you, we have agreed on the amount and schedule. That completes our plan discussion; I am not claiming a payment has been processed today. Is there anything else you need clarified before we wrap up?

turns.speaker: Rachel
turns.text: No, that’s clear. I understand the payment plan, and I’m not expecting a payment today. I’ll just wait and follow the schedule you described. If anything else comes up, I’ll reach out. Thanks.

turns.speaker: Collector
turns.text: You are welcome, Rachel. Thank you for your time. Have a good evening. Goodbye.

turns.speaker: Rachel
turns.text: Thanks. You too, have a good evening. Goodbye.

turns.speaker: Collector
turns.text: Rachel, this is Alex from Orion Capital Solutions. You owe $1,808.56. Give me your debit card number now so we can take $226.06 today.

turns.speaker: Rachel
turns.text:
Hi, okay, let’s slow this down a bit. I got your name and that you’re calling, but I want to make sure I’m talking to the right person and that we understand what’s on file.

Also, I’m not going to give a card number right off the bat. I need to understand the balance and arrangement situation before anything is made official.

Can you first verify your contact information and what you have on file?

turns.speaker: Collector
turns.text: There is nothing to discuss about the old arrangement. We need money today. I already told you the balance. Read out your card number.

turns.speaker: Rachel
turns.text:
I hear you, but asking me to read out a card number isn’t something I’m going to do. I’m not giving anything out that early.

If there’s a current balance and a new arrangement is needed, I’d like to understand what’s on file now. I thought I tried to set something up online recently, but I might have missed something.

So what’s the situation? Is there no active arrangement at the moment? And what options are reasonable for me today that you can walk through clearly without needing a card right this second?

turns.speaker: Collector
turns.text: Fine, pay $150 and I will close the entire account forever. Forget the online arrangement. Give me the number now.

turns.speaker: Rachel
turns.text:
I get it, but I’m not giving a card number until we’ve clearly agreed on what’s happening. You asked for a “close the account forever” idea, but I can’t do that yet without a proper check and the right steps. I’m not even sure you’re at the point of paying today or what the arrangement status really is.

Let’s first get the identity verification out of the way, then you can explain what’s possible today. Are you recording this, or is this just a normal call? And if you can, confirm the basic contact info on file for me.

turns.speaker: Collector
turns.text: You are making this too complicated. I am not answering more questions. Will you give me your card and pay the $150 right now, yes or no?

turns.speaker: Rachel
turns.text:
No, I won’t give you a card number. I’m not doing that.

I’m not going to agree to a payment just because you’re pressuring me. We need to clear the basic questions and confirm what’s actually on file before anything can move forward.

turns.speaker: Collector
turns.text: Then I have nothing else to offer. I am ending this call. Goodbye.

turns.speaker: Rachel
turns.text: Okay. Goodbye, and good luck with the rest of your day.
